newsitem.title: JAPAN: U.S. to closely monitor Japan deregulation--Lang.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to closely monitor Japan deregulation--Lang.

text.p: Deputy U.S. Trade Representative Jeffrey Lang said on Monday that the United States would continue to monitor Japan's financial deregulation plans closely.
Lang, on a one-day visit to Japan, spoke after meeting Haruhiko Kuroda, director-general of the Finance Ministry's International Finance Bureau.
Lang told reporters he mainly discussed liberalisation of financial services under the World Trade Organisation during the meeting.
Asked if the United States was satisfied with progress in Japan's financial deregulation, Lang said: "We will continue to monitor the situation closely."
He said he did not discuss Japan's trade surplus with Kuroda.
